question.prompt:
A rectangle has a length of 4 cm and a width of 3 cm. It is rotated through one full revolution about the line containing its longer side to form a cylinder. Taking \(\pi=3.14\), what is the volume of this cylinder in \(\mathrm{cm}^3\)? (Round the result to two decimal places.)

[Figure 1](figures/cnm_052_q5_question_en.svg)

solutions.explanation: Rotating about the longer side gives a cylinder with height 4 and base radius 3. Its volume is \(V=\pi\times3^2\times4=36\pi=36\times3.14=113.04\).
solutions.title: Identify cylinder dimensions and calculate volume
